newsitem.title: USA: Stocks coast to slightly lower close.
newsitem.headline: Stocks coast to slightly lower close.

text.p: Stock prices ended slightly lower Thursday as Wall Street turned cautious ahead of Friday's important jobs report for February.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 1.15 points at 6,944.70. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 526 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
